title: 49470013-Dungeons_Dragons_Heroes.xiso.iso
route:
# Dungeons & Dragons Heroes (49470013): first-run route (the default hero
# is not saved before control). PLAYED by nav.py on the Thor, 2026-09-27
# 07:14 PDT (lane.titleroutes HELD session dnd-heroes.first-run-20260927T071435).
#
#   the Bink and publisher logos -> three A presses 5 s apart, which went
#   through the title and the menus unseen -> the hero select, FIGHTER
#   Human, "Press START to Join" for player 2 (A) -> Name Your Hero with the
#   default "ARADIN" (A) -> "Loading" with a Types of Spells card -> the
#   opening cutscene with the dwarves (A and START do not end it; it runs
#   about 40 s warm, much longer cold) -> ARADIN in the ruins, health and
#   mana bars, keys and potions 0/0/0.
#
# The three unseen A presses are the fragile part: if the menus come at a
# different pace, the replay frames show where it stopped.
#
# NOT yet replayed. Two replays of the nav session's draft failed: replay 1
# marked inside the cutscene, which ran at 2 fps; replay 2 was in play when
# the draft's START landed, which opened Game Options, and the play
# pattern's A then chose Save Game. This version drops that START and waits
# 150 s after `skip` for the cutscene to end. A spare A in play is an attack.
#
# Still NOT replayed (2026-09-27 12:30 PDT). This version's soak,
# 0-0-x-1790527983-titleroutes-2100395, is void for a reason outside the
# route: hakuX rendered on display 0 but did not have the Thor's input
# focus, so no press reached the game. The title sat in its own loop, the
# main menu for about 40 s and then the attract demo for about 80 s, and
# the frames `name`, `load` and `skip` are that demo (heroes with keys and
# potions already collected). One thing it did show: on a cold boot the
# main menu, NEW GAME highlighted, is up about 55 s after launch with no
# press at all (`a3`).
#
# Player control: LY min walked the fighter down the screen, A and X
# attacked; X also opens the skill list (Avid Pursuit, War Cry, Thrown
# Dagger), so the play pattern presses A only. Nav frames 008-gameplay ->
# 009-moved.
#
# REPLAYED 2026-09-27 13:04 PDT, in a HELD Thor session, unattended, with
# hakuX holding the input focus on all 17 reads of `dumpsys input`. The frame
# at the mark is ARADIN in the ruins, out of the cutscene (overlay FPS 15);
# 40 s later he stands at the torch-lit sign further on
# (scratch/replay/dnd-heroes-130437/zz-end.png, FPS 11). The boot was warm.
wait 26.8
shot boot
wait 9.6
press A
wait 5.4
press A
wait 5.4
press A
wait 5.1
shot a3
wait 9.2
press A
wait 6.1
shot fighter
wait 10.9
press A
wait 6.1
shot name
wait 24.5
shot load
wait 9.1
press A
wait 5.4
press A
wait 5.1
shot skip
wait 60
shot cut2
wait 90
mark gameplay
repeat forever {
    axis LY min
    wait 2
    press A
    axis LX max
    wait 1
    press A
    axis LX mid
    axis LY max
    wait 2
    press A
    axis LX min
    wait 1
    press A
    axis LX mid
    axis LY mid
    wait 0.5
}
